Graduate Tuition and Fees

Graduate tuition for the 2026-27 academic year is $1,200 per credit hour for residents.

International graduate students pay $24,000 per academic year in tuition for full-time enrollment.

The application fee for all graduate programs is $75 and is non-refundable. Additional fees may apply for some programs, and amounts are subject to change by the Board of Regents each year.
